task: Each source has two targets: finite2 with new response parameters, or recurrent with the original response parameters. Both targets share paid prefix controls. Private family labels and seeds appear only in the experiment protocol/results.
source: Learn one source per new apparatus with live Luna and the common three-trajectory prefix. Only its actual freshly confirmed predictor is published. No supplied formula, source replacement, repeated source attempt, or terminal-based admission.
intervention: Persistent advice versus the preceding event-only advice. The experiment baseline disables only pending-advice fallback and the cached advice field in research_state. Both conditions retain original event feedback, explicit research_choice, all numerical operators, identical prompts and equal budgets.
controller: Every action after the matched three-trajectory prefix is selected by Luna. Neither condition forces an initial action or follows advice automatically. Same model, prompt, tools, budgets and confirmation seeds; maximum 12 model calls.
archive_publication: New predictors retain ordinary code, data and binary dependencies. Imported confirmed-model archives accompany them only when declared in the successful finish.reused_files. Runner logs and the undeclared candidate catalog are excluded. An unchanged directly submitted archive keeps its existing dependencies. Revisions to an inherited model publish a new candidate. A latest predictor explicitly depending on an older candidate retains that dependency, which is reported.
failure_policy: A source without fresh confirmation blocks its four dependent target episodes. Keep their registered slots, failed source costs and failure reason; do not replace sources or report only the selected successful sources. Target failures and service interruptions remain in the registered cohort.
accounting: Each of four sources is physically learned once. Report actual source plus all target costs, and each condition's target costs with shared source costs added once separately. Preserve incomplete usage rather than estimating tokens.
terminal_order: All source and target learning ends before any terminal evaluation. Source publication uses fresh confirmation only; terminal outcomes never filter jobs.
scope: Four new apparatus parameter realizations, each with one response change and one recurrent-instrument change; two target conditions per change. Four independent apparatus units, eight paired targets, sixteen registered target episodes, plus four shared sources. This tests advice persistence within existing families, not vanilla versus Hegel or an open-world capability claim.
model_identity: gpt-6-luna is requested through the existing subscription provider. Usage metadata repeating that name does not independently establish server routing.
adoption: Both conditions show original event advice. Record actual render opportunities privately; only the last recommendation in an event is matched against the next actual action. Pending advice after an unrelated action also counts as a new opportunity. Exact matching does not infer adoption from free text.
